select
 dept_code as 科室代码,
 dept_name as 科室名称
 from dept_dict where outp_or_inp = 0 and clinic_attr <>2

select
o.patient_id as ID号,
p.name as 患者姓名,
(select dept_name from dept_dict where dept_code=om.dept_stayed) as 科室名称,
d.diagnosis_code as 主诊断编码,
d.diagnosis_desc as 主诊断名称,
to_char(o.operating_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') as 日期,
o.operation_code as 手术编码,
o.operation_desc as 手术名称,
o.anaesthesia_method as 麻醉方式,
o.operation_scale as 手术等级,
o.wound_grade as 切口等级,
(CASE LENGTH(om.surgeon)
  WHEN 6 THEN (select name from staff_dict sd where sd.emp_no=om.surgeon)
  ELSE om.surgeon END) as 术者
from operation o
full join pat_master_index p
on p.patient_id = o.patient_id
full join diagnosis d
on (d.patient_id = o.patient_id
and d.visit_id = o.visit_id
and d.diagnosis_no = 1
and d.diagnosis_type = 3)
full join operation_master om
on (om.patient_id = o.patient_id
and om.visit_id = o.visit_id
and om.oper_id = o.operation_no
)
where 
om.dept_stayed in ('?,'?)
and o.operating_date >= to_date('?, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
and o.operating_date < to_date('?, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
order by o.operating_date asc

select d.dept_code, d.dept_name
from dept_dict d
where d.stop_flag is null and outp_or_inp = 1
select *from DEPT_OI_ATTR_DICT

select (select dept_name from dept_dict where dept_code=t.dept_admission_to) as 入院科室,
(select dept_name from dept_dict where dept_code=t.dept_discharge_from) as 出院科室,  t.* from pat_visit t 
where (CLINICAL_PATHWAY_FINISH is not null or CLINICAL_PATHWAY_VARIATION is not null)
and t.discharge_date_time >=to_date('?,'yyyymmdd')

select
v.patient_id id号,
p.inp_no 住院次数,
v.visit_id 住院次数,
p.name 姓名,
floor((v.admission_date_time - p.date_of_birth)/365) 年龄,
v.admission_date_time 入院时间,
v.discharge_date_time 出院时间,
(select dept_name from dept_dict where dept_code = v.dept_admission_to) 入院科室,
(select dept_name from dept_dict where dept_code = v.dept_discharge_from) 出院科室,
(select d.diagnosis_code ||'-'|| d.diagnosis_desc from diagnosis d where d.patient_id = v.patient_id and d.visit_id = v.visit_id
and d.diagnosis_type = 3 and d.diagnosis_no = 1) 出院主诊断,
case floor((v.discharge_date_time - v.admission_date_time)) when 0 then 1 else floor((v.discharge_date_time - v.admission_date_time)) end 住院天数,
(select sum(ibd.charges) from inp_bill_detail ibd where ibd.patient_id = v.patient_id and ibd.visit_id = v.visit_id) 住院花费,
(select to_char(WM_CONCAT(o.operation_code ||'-'||  o.operation_desc)) from operation o where o.patient_id = v.patient_id and o.visit_id = v.visit_id
and (o.operation_desc like '%胃癌根治术%' or o.operation_desc like '%胃部分切除术%' or o.operation_desc like '%全胃切除术%')) 符合条件手术
from pat_visit v, pat_master_index p
where v.discharge_date_time >= to_date('?,'yyyyMMdd')
and v.discharge_date_time < to_date('?,'yyyyMMdd')
and v.patient_id = p.patient_id
and (select count(1) from operation o where o.patient_id = v.patient_id and o.visit_id = v.visit_id
and ( o.operation_desc like '%胃癌根治术%'or o.operation_desc like '%胃部分切除术%' or 
o.operation_desc like '%全胃切除术%'
)) > 0

create table INSUR_EXPORT.住院费用明细清单 as
(select a.patient_id || a.visit_id as 唯一就诊标识,
       b.inp_no as 住院号,
       a.visit_id as 住院次数,
       c.brjsh as 住院流水号,
       b.name as 姓名,
       b.sex as 性别,
       b.id_no as 身份证号码,
       FLOOR(MONTHS_BETWEEN(a.billing_date_time, b.date_of_birth) / 12) as 就医年龄,
       c.admission_date_time as 住院日期,
       c.discharge_date_time as 出院日期,
       (select dept_name from dept_dict where dept_code= c.dept_admission_to) as 入院科室,
       (select dept_name from dept_dict where dept_code= c.dept_discharge_from) as 出院科室,
       (case
         when a.item_class in ('C', 'D') then
          a.oper_code
       end) as 单据号,
       ' ' as 物价编码,
       a.item_code as 医院项目编码,
       a.item_name as 医院项目名称,
       a.item_spec as 规格,
       a.item_price as 单价,
       a.units as 计量单位,
       a.amount as 数量,
       a.costs as 金额,
       a.billing_date_time as 费用发生时间,
       (select dept_name from dept_dict where dept_code= a.ORDERED_BY) as 开单科室,
      (select dept_name from dept_dict where dept_code=  a.PERFORMED_BY) as 计费科室,
       (case
         when a.item_class in ('A', 'B') then
          '药品'
         when a.item_class in ('I') then
          '服务设施'
         else
          '诊疗项目'
       end) as 费用大类,
       (SELECT r.class_name
          FROM BILL_ITEM_CLASS_DICT r
         WHERE r.class_code = a.item_class) as 收费类别,
       e.settling_date 结算日期

  from inp_bill_detail a
  left join pat_master_index b
    on a.patient_id = b.patient_id
  left join pat_visit c
    on a.patient_id = c.patient_id
   and a.visit_id = c.visit_id
   , inp_settle_master e
 where e.settling_date >=
       to_date('?, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
   and e.settling_date <
       to_date('?, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
   and a.rcpt_no = e.rcpt_no
   and e.transact_type = '正常')

create table INSUR_EXPORT.门诊诊断明细表 as
   (select b.clinic_no as 唯一就诊标识,
       a.patient_id as 门诊号,

       a.item_no as 诊断序号,

and trunc(a.visit_date)<to_date('?,'yyyy-mm-dd')
)

create table INSUR_EXPORT.化验记录表 as(
select 
       case when a.visit_id ='0' then (select cc.clinic_no
                   from outp_treat_rec s,outp_orders cc
                  where a.test_no = s.appoint_no and s.serial_no = cc.serial_no  and rownum =1)

       b.item_code as 套餐包编码,

       c.REPORT_ITEM_CODE as 详细化验项目编号,

       c.result as 化验结果,

from lab_test_master a

select 
(select dept_name from dept_dict where dept_code = v.dept_discharge_from) 科室,
sum((select min(o.operating_date) from operation o where o.patient_id = v.patient_id and o.visit_id = v.visit_id) - v.admission_date_time) 术前住院天数和,

from pat_visit v
where v.discharge_date_time >= to_date('?,'yyyyMMdd')
and v.discharge_date_time < to_date('?,'yyyyMMdd')
and v.dept_discharge_from in 
('?,'?,'?,'?,'?,'?,'?,'?,'?,'?,'?,'?,'?,'?,'?,'?,'?,'?,'?,'?,'?）
and (select count(1) from operation o where o.patient_id = v.patient_id and o.visit_id = v.visit_id) > 0
group by v.dept_discharge_from

  
--各科室四级手术前三位  
select * from (
select 科室,listagg(手术,',') within group (order by 科室, 排名) 手术,排名 from 
(select 科室,手术,rank() over(partition by 科室 order by 数量 desc) as 排名 from
  (select 科室, 手术编码||'-'||手术名称 手术,count(1) 数量
  from (select
  (select dept_name from dept_dict where dept_code = v.dept_discharge_from) 科室,
  o.operation_code 手术编码,
  o.operation_desc 手术名称

  and v.discharge_date_time >= to_date('?,'yyyyMMdd')
  and v.discharge_date_time < to_date('?,'yyyyMMdd')
  and v.dept_discharge_from in 
('?,'?,'?,'?,'?,'?,'?,'?,'?,'?,'?,'?,'?,'?,'?,'?,'?,'?,'?,'?,'?）
  and o.operation_scale = '4') group by 科室,手术编码||'-'||手术名称 order by 科室 asc, 数量 desc))
  where 排名 <= 3 group by 科室, 排名 ) pivot(max(手术) for 排名 in (1,2,3) )
  
  
 --各科室门诊量

  and c.visit_date < to_date('?,'yyyyMMdd')
  group by c.visit_dept

select a.* from
(
select 
dd.dept_name 科室,
'入院人数' 类别,
count(1) 总人数
from pat_visit v, dept_dict dd
where v.discharge_date_time >= to_date('?,'yyyyMMdd')
and v.discharge_date_time < to_date('?,'yyyyMMdd')
and v.dept_discharge_from = dd.dept_code
group by dd.dept_name
union all
select 
dd.dept_name 科室,
'手术数' 类别,
count(1) 总人数
from pat_visit v, dept_dict dd
where v.discharge_date_time >= to_date('?,'yyyyMMdd')
and v.discharge_date_time < to_date('?,'yyyyMMdd')
and (select count(1) from operation o where o.patient_id = v.patient_id and o.visit_id = v.visit_id) > 0
and v.dept_discharge_from = dd.dept_code
group by dd.dept_name
union all
select 
dd.dept_name 科室,
'四级手术' 类别,
count(1) 总人数
from pat_visit v, dept_dict dd
where v.discharge_date_time >= to_date('?,'yyyyMMdd')
and v.discharge_date_time < to_date('?,'yyyyMMdd')
and (select count(1) from operation o where o.patient_id = v.patient_id and o.visit_id = v.visit_id 
and (select count(1) from operation_dict od where od.operation_code = o.operation_code and od.stop_flag = 0
and od.operation_scale = '四') > 0) > 0
and v.dept_discharge_from = dd.dept_code
group by dd.dept_name
union all
select 
dd.dept_name 科室,
'三级手术' 类别,
count(1) 总人数
from pat_visit v, dept_dict dd
where v.discharge_date_time >= to_date('?,'yyyyMMdd')
and v.discharge_date_time < to_date('?,'yyyyMMdd')
and ((select count(1) from operation o where o.patient_id = v.patient_id and o.visit_id = v.visit_id 
and (select count(1) from operation_dict od where od.operation_code = o.operation_code and od.stop_flag = 0
and od.operation_scale = '四') > 0) = 0 and (select count(1) from operation o where o.patient_id = v.patient_id and o.visit_id = v.visit_id 
and (select count(1) from operation_dict od where od.operation_code = o.operation_code and od.stop_flag = 0
and od.operation_scale = '三') > 0) > 0)
and v.dept_discharge_from = dd.dept_code
group by dd.dept_name
union all
select 
dd.dept_name 科室,
'介入手术' 类别,
count(1) 总人数
from pat_visit v, dept_dict dd
where v.discharge_date_time >= to_date('?,'yyyyMMdd')
and v.discharge_date_time < to_date('?,'yyyyMMdd')

and (select count(1) from operation_dict od where od.operation_code = o.operation_code and od.stop_flag = 0
and  od.operation_indicator = 3) > 0) > 0
and v.dept_discharge_from = dd.dept_code
group by dd.dept_name

  pivot(max(总人数)

SELECT *
  FROM (select aa.patient_id 病人ID,
               (select inp_no
                  from pat_master_index
                 where patient_id = aa.patient_id) 住院号,
               (select name
                  from pat_master_index
                 where patient_id = aa.patient_id) 病人姓名,
               aa.visit_id 住院次数,
               (select c.admission_date_time
                  from pat_visit c
                 where patient_id = aa.patient_id
                   and visit_id = aa.visit_id) 入院日期,
               (select dept_name
                  from dept_dict
                 where dept_code = aa.dept_code) 病人所科室,
               bb.class_name 项目类别,
               nvl(sum(aa.charges), 0) 金额
          from (select *
                  from inp_bill_detail a
                -- where a.billing_date_time>=to_date('','yyyy-mm-dd') --费用发生时间，如果需要加日期条件
                --and a.billing_date_time<to_date('','yyyy-mm-dd')
                ) aa,
               reck_item_class_dict bb
         where aa.class_on_reckoning = bb.class_code
           and (aa.patient_id, aa.visit_id) in
               (select 病人ID, 住院次数
                  from (select (select dept_name
                                  from dept_dict
                                 where dept_code = a.clinic_dept) 门诊科室,
                               a.user_name 医生,
                               a.patient_id 病人ID,
                               d.visit_id 住院次数,
                               a.name 病人姓名,
                               a.date_of_birth 病人出生日期,
                               a.registering_date 开证时间,
                               d.admission_date_time 入院时间,
                               (select dept_name
                                  from dept_dict
                                 where dept_code = d.dept_admission_to) 入院科室
                          from (select a.*, t.name user_name
                                  from wait_bed_pats_new a, staff_dict t
                                 where a.consulting_doctor = t.emp_no) a,
                               pat_visit d
                         where a.clinic_dept like '0144%'
                           and d.patient_id = a.patient_id
                           and a.dept_waiting_for = d.dept_admission_to
                           and a.user_name = d.consulting_doctor
                           and a.registering_date >=
                               to_date('?, 'yyyy-mm-dd') --开住院证时间
                           and a.registering_date <
                               to_date('?, 'yyyy-mm-dd'))
                 where 入院时间 - 开证时间 <= 7 and 入院时间 - 开证时间 >= 0)
         group by bb.class_name, aa.dept_code,aa.patient_id,aa.visit_id)
          PIVOT(SUM(金额) FOR 项目类别 IN('治疗费' AS 治疗费,

select 
c.dept_name 科室,aa.num1 as ICU患者病死数,bb.num2 as ICU患者数,round(aa.num1/bb.num2,4) as ICU患者病死率,TO_CHAR(aa.discharge_date_time, 'YYYY-MM') AS 月份
from
(
select count(distinct(a.patient_id)) num1, 
       TRUNC(a.discharge_date_time, 'MONTH') AS discharge_date_time,
       dept_admission_to

from pat_visit a,orders b

where a.patient_id = b.patient_id
and a.visit_id = b.visit_id
and b.order_code = 'LCSW001'
and b.order_status = '2'
and  ((a.discharge_date_time >= to_date('?, 'yyyy-mm-dd') and
       a.discharge_date_time < to_date('?, 'yyyy-mm-dd'))
    or (
       a.admission_date_time < to_date('?, 'yyyy-mm-dd') and
        a.discharge_date_time is null) )
and a.discharge_date_time is not null
and a.dept_admission_to = '?
group by TRUNC(a.discharge_date_time, 'MONTH'),dept_admission_to
) aa
JOIN
(select sum(a.bed_used_num) num2,TRUNC(a.st_date, 'MONTH') AS st_date,a.dept_code
from dept_adt_day a  where a.st_date >= TO_DATE('?, 'yyyy-mm-dd') 
and a.st_date < TO_DATE('?, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
and a.dept_code = '?
group by a.dept_code,TRUNC(a.st_date, 'MONTH')
) bb
on aa.discharge_date_time = bb.st_date
and aa.dept_admission_to = bb.dept_code
join dept_dict c
on aa.dept_admission_to = c.dept_code
group by aa.num1,bb.num2,TO_CHAR(aa.discharge_date_time, 'YYYY-MM'),c.dept_name

select 
c.dept_name 科室,aa.num1 as ICU患者病死数,bb.num2 as ICU患者数,round(aa.num1/bb.num2,4) as ICU患者病死率,TO_CHAR(aa.discharge_date_time, 'YYYY-MM') AS 月份
from
(
select count(distinct(a.patient_id)) num1, 
       TRUNC(a.discharge_date_time, 'MONTH') AS discharge_date_time,
       dept_admission_to

from pat_visit a,orders b

where a.patient_id = b.patient_id
and a.visit_id = b.visit_id
and b.order_code = 'LCSW001'
and b.order_status = '2'
and  ((a.discharge_date_time >= to_date('?, 'yyyy-mm-dd') and
       a.discharge_date_time < to_date('?, 'yyyy-mm-dd'))
    or (
       a.admission_date_time < to_date('?, 'yyyy-mm-dd') and
        a.discharge_date_time is null) )
and a.discharge_date_time is not null
and a.dept_admission_to in('?,'?)
group by TRUNC(a.discharge_date_time, 'MONTH'),dept_admission_to
) aa
JOIN
(select count(distinct(a.patient_id)) num2, 
       TRUNC(a.discharge_date_time, 'MONTH') AS discharge_date_time,
       dept_admission_to
from pat_visit a
where
((a.discharge_date_time >= to_date('?, 'yyyy-mm-dd') and
       a.discharge_date_time < to_date('?, 'yyyy-mm-dd'))
    or (
       a.admission_date_time < to_date('?, 'yyyy-mm-dd') and
        a.discharge_date_time is null) )
and a.discharge_date_time is not null
and a.dept_admission_to in('?,'?)
group by TRUNC(a.discharge_date_time, 'MONTH'),dept_admission_to
) bb
on aa.discharge_date_time = bb.discharge_date_time
and aa.dept_admission_to = bb.dept_admission_to
join dept_dict c
on aa.dept_admission_to = c.dept_code
group by aa.num1,bb.num2,TO_CHAR(aa.discharge_date_time, 'YYYY-MM'),c.dept_name

SELECT d.inp_no,d.name,e.dept_name,c.operation_desc，c.operating_date,f.name,a.discharge_date_time
    FROM pat_visit a, orders b,operation c,pat_master_index d,dept_dict e,staff_dict f
    WHERE a.patient_id = b.patient_id
        AND a.visit_id = b.visit_id
        and a.patient_id = c.patient_id
        and a.visit_id = c.visit_id
        and a.patient_id = d.patient_id
        and a.dept_admission_to = e.dept_code
        and c.operator = f.emp_no
        AND b.order_code = 'LCSW001'
        and b.order_status = '2'
        AND c.operating_date >= TO_DATE('?, 'yyyy-mm-dd')

SELECT c.dept_name as 科室, 
       TO_CHAR(aa.operating_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS 月份,
       aa.num1 as 手术患者死亡人数,
       bb.num2 as 手术人数,
       round(aa.num1 / bb.num2,4) AS 手术死亡率
       
FROM
(
    SELECT dept_admission_to, COUNT(DISTINCT c.patient_id) AS num1,trunc(c.operating_date,'MONTH') as operating_date
    FROM pat_visit a, orders b,operation c
    WHERE a.patient_id = b.patient_id
        AND a.visit_id = b.visit_id
        and a.patient_id = c.patient_id
        and a.visit_id = c.visit_id
        AND b.order_code = 'LCSW001'
        and b.order_status = '2'
        AND c.operating_date >= TO_DATE('?, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
        AND c.operating_date < TO_DATE('?, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
        and a.discharge_date_time is not null
        and c.operation_no is not null
    GROUP BY dept_admission_to,trunc(c.operating_date,'MONTH')
) aa
JOIN
(
    SELECT dept_admission_to, COUNT(DISTINCT c.patient_id) AS num2,trunc(c.operating_date,'MONTH') as operating_date
    FROM pat_visit a,operation c
    WHERE operating_date >= TO_DATE('?, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
        AND operating_date < TO_DATE('?, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
        and a.patient_id = c.patient_id
        and a.visit_id = c.visit_id
        and c.operation_no is not null
    GROUP BY dept_admission_to,trunc(c.operating_date,'MONTH')
) bb
ON aa.dept_admission_to = bb.dept_admission_to
   AND aa.operating_date = bb.operating_date
join dept_dict c
on aa.dept_admission_to = c.dept_code
GROUP BY c.dept_name, bb.num2,aa.num1,TO_CHAR(aa.operating_date, 'YYYY-MM')

  from (select (select aa.dept_name
                  from dept_dict aa
                 where aa.dept_code = a.operating_dept) 科室,
               sum(CEIL(a.start_date_time - b.admission_date_time)) 术前住院时间,
               sum(CEIL(b.discharge_date_time - b.admission_date_time)) 总住院日,
               CEIL(sum(CEIL(b.discharge_date_time - b.admission_date_time)) /
                    sum(CEIL(a.start_date_time - b.admission_date_time))) 术前平均住院日,
               0 as 术后住院日,
               0 as 总住院日,
               0 as 术后平均住院日
          from operation_schedule c, operation_master a, pat_visit b
         where c.patient_id = a.patient_id
           and c.visit_id = a.visit_id
           and a.patient_id = b.patient_id
           and a.visit_id = b.visit_id
           and c.ack_indicator = 1
           and b.discharge_date_time >= comm.f_todate('?)
           and b.discharge_date_time < comm.f_todate('?)
         group by a.operating_dept
        union all
        select (select aa.dept_name
                  from dept_dict aa
                 where aa.dept_code = a.operating_dept) 科室,
               0 as 术前住院时间,
               0 as 总住院日,
               0 as 术前平均住院日,
               sum(CEIL(b.discharge_date_time - a.end_date_time)) 术后住院日,
               sum(CEIL(b.discharge_date_time - b.admission_date_time)) 总住院日,
               CEIL(sum(CEIL(b.discharge_date_time - b.admission_date_time)) /
                    sum(CEIL(b.discharge_date_time - a.end_date_time))) 术后平均住院日
          from operation_schedule c, operation_master a, pat_visit b
         where c.patient_id = a.patient_id
           and c.visit_id = a.visit_id
           and a.patient_id = b.patient_id
           and a.visit_id = b.visit_id
           and c.ack_indicator = 1
           and b.discharge_date_time >= comm.f_todate('?)
           and b.discharge_date_time < comm.f_todate('?)
         group by a.operating_dept) a
 group by 科室

create  table  INSUR_EXPORT.病理病人清单 as(

select aaa.*, bbb.blh 病理号,
bbb.hyxmbm 详细化验项目编号,
bbb.hyxmmc 详细化验项目名称,
bbb.lczd 临床诊断,
bbb.bbmc 标本名称,
bbb.bgjg 报告结果
 from

(--住院
select
distinct 
p.patient_id HISid号,
p.patient_id||'-'||ibd.visit_id 唯一就诊标识,
p.inp_no 住院号,
p.patient_id 就诊标识,
--'' 病理号,
'住院' 就诊类型,
to_char(ibd.billing_date_time, 'yyyy-MM-dd') 计费时间,
p.name 病人姓名,
p.id_no 身份证号,
(select dept_name from dept_dict where dept_code = ibd.ordered_by) 开单科室,
(select dept_name from dept_dict where dept_code = ibd.performed_by) 执行科室,
ibd.visit_id 住院次数
--ibd.item_code 计费项目编码,
--ibd.item_name 计费项目名称,
--ibd.item_code
from inp_bill_detail ibd, pat_master_index p, reck_item_class_dict r
where ibd.patient_id = p.patient_id
-- and ibd.outp_rcpt_no is null
and ibd.billing_date_time>to_date('?,'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
and ibd.billing_date_time<to_date('?,'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
and ibd.class_on_reckoning = r.class_code
and ibd.item_code = '270400002-1'
union all
-- 门诊
SELECT 
distinct
c.patient_id HISid号,
c.patient_id||'-'|| to_char(c.visit_date, 'yyyymmdd') || c.visit_no
 唯一就诊标识,
'' 住院号,
p.patient_id 就诊标识,
'门诊' 就诊类型,
to_char(b.visit_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd')  计费时间,
p.name 病人姓名,
p.id_no 身份证号,
D1.Dept_Name 开单科室,
D.DEPT_NAME 执行科室,
0 住院次数
                  FROM RECK_ITEM_CLASS_DICT A,
                       OUTP_BILL_ITEMS      B,
                       OUTP_ORDER_DESC      C,
                       DEPT_DICT            D,
                       dept_dict            d1,
                       pat_master_index     p
                 WHERE B.RCPT_NO = C.RCPT_NO
                   AND A.CLASS_CODE = B.CLASS_ON_RECKONING
                   AND B.VISIT_NO = C.VISIT_NO
                   AND B.VISIT_DATE = C.VISIT_DATE
                   AND B.PERFORMED_BY = D.DEPT_CODE(+)
                   and b.ordered_by_dept = D1.DEPT_CODE(+)
                   and p.patient_id = c.patient_id
                   AND B.VISIT_DATE >= to_date('?,'yyyyMMdd')
                   AND B.VISIT_DATE < to_date('?,'yyyyMMdd')
                   and item_code = '270400002-1') aaa
                   left join (select 
            p.patient_id hisid,
            case ltm.visit_id when 0 then (select p.patient_id||'-'||to_char(ot.visit_date,'yyyyMMdd') from outp_treat_rec ot where ot.appoint_no = ltm.test_no and rownum=1) 
              else p.inp_no||'-'||ltm.visit_id end as zylshmzbm,
            case ltm.visit_id when 0 then null else p.inp_no end zyh,
            case ltm.visit_id when 0 then (select p.patient_id||'-'||to_char(ot.visit_date,'yyyyMMdd') from outp_treat_rec ot where ot.appoint_no = ltm.test_no and rownum=1)  
              else p.inp_no end jzbs,
            ltm.test_no blh,
            case ltm.visit_id when 0 then '门诊' else '住院' end jzlb,
            ltm.requested_date_time sjsj,
            p.name xm,
            p.id_no shfzhm,
            (select dept_name from dept_dict where dept_code = ltm.ordering_dept) kdks,
            (select dept_name from dept_dict where dept_code = ltm.performed_by) zhxks,
            lti.item_code hyxmbm,
            lti.item_name hyxmmc,
            ltm.relevant_clinic_diag lczd,
            ltm.specimen bbmc,
            (select to_char(WM_CONCAT(lr.recommendation)) from lab_result lr where ltm.test_no = lr.test_no)  bgjg,
            ltm.visit_id zycs
            from lab_test_master ltm, lab_test_items lti, pat_master_index p
            where ltm.performed_by = '?
            and ltm.requested_date_time >= to_date('?, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
            and ltm.requested_date_time < to_date('?, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
            and ltm.test_no = lti.test_no
            and ltm.patient_id = p.patient_id
            and lti.item_code in (select clinic_item_code from clinic_vs_charge where charge_item_code like '270400002%')) bbb
            on (aaa.HISid号 = bbb.hisid and aaa.住院次数=bbb.zycs)
            )

create  table  INSUR_EXPORT.住院病人就医信息表 as(
select
brqd.唯一就诊标识 as 唯一就诊标识,
p.inp_no as 住院号,
brqd.唯一就诊标识 as 住院流水号,
p.inp_no as 上传医保住院号,
p.id_no as 姓名,
p.sex as 性别,
p.date_of_birth as 出生日期,
floor((v.admission_date_time - p.date_of_birth)/365) 就医年龄,
v.admission_date_time as 入院日期,
v.discharge_date_time as 出院日期,
e.settling_date as 结算日期,
ddd.diagnosis_code 主诊断代码,
ddd.diagnosis_desc 主诊断名称,
(select dept_name from dept_dict where dept_code = v.dept_discharge_from) 科室名称,
(select name from staff_dict where emp_no = v.attending_doctor) 主治医生,
(select discharge_disposition_name from discharge_disposition_dict where discharge_disposition_code = v.discharge_disposition) 出院方式,
e.charges 总费用,
v.charge_type 人员类别,
(select sum(yb.ybfdje) from inp_settle_master_yb yb where yb.patient_id = v.patient_id and yb.visit_id = v.visit_id) 报销金额,
(e.charges - (select sum(yb.ybfdje) from inp_settle_master_yb yb where yb.patient_id = v.patient_id and yb.visit_id = v.visit_id)) 自费金额,
' ' 结算类型,
' ' 病组病种编码,
' ' 病组病种名称,
' '病组病种金额,
e.transact_type 撤销标识
from pat_visit v, INSUR_EXPORT.病理病人清单 brqd, pat_master_index p, diagnosis ddd, 
(select ism.patient_id, ism.visit_id, to_char(ism.settling_date,'yyyy-MM-dd') settling_date, 
ism.transact_type,sum(ism.charges) charges from inp_settle_master ism,INSUR_EXPORT.病理病人清单 qd  
where ism.patient_id = qd.hisid号 and ism.visit_id = qd.住院次数 and ism.transact_type = '正常' 
group by ism.patient_id, ism.visit_id, to_char(ism.settling_date,'yyyy-MM-dd'),ism.transact_type) e
where v.patient_id = brqd.hisid号 and v.visit_id = brqd.住院次数
and v.patient_id = p.patient_id
and v.patient_id = e.patient_id and v.visit_id = e.visit_id
and e.transact_type = '正常'
and v.patient_id = ddd.patient_id and v.visit_id = ddd.visit_id
and ddd.diagnosis_type = 3 and ddd.diagnosis_no = 1)

create  table  INSUR_EXPORT.门诊病人就医信息表 as (

select distinct b.patient_id||'-'|| to_char(b.visit_date, 'yyyymmdd') || b.visit_no 唯一就诊标识, --唯一就诊标识
                a.PATIENT_ID 门诊编号, --门诊编号
                b.CLINIC_NO 上传医保门诊编号, --门诊流水号/住院流水号
                d.id_no 医保卡号, --医保卡号
                d.id_no 身份证号码, --证件号码
                c.name 姓名, --姓名
                DECODE(d.sex, '男', 1, '女', 1, 9) 性别, --性别   1:男,2:女,9:未说明
                d.date_of_birth 出生日期, --出生日期
                c.age 年龄, --年龄
                d.mailing_address 地址, --现住址；患者近期的常住地址
                a.visit_date 就诊日期, --就诊结算日期
                a.visit_date 结算日期,
                
                (SELECT listagg(diag_code, ',') within group(ORDER BY item_no)
                   from outp_mr_diag_desc f
                  where f.visit_date = c.visit_date
                    and f.visit_no = c.visit_no
                    and f.patient_id = c.patient_id) 诊断代码, -- 诊断编码
                (SELECT listagg(diag_desc, ',') within group(ORDER BY item_no)
                   from outp_mr_diag_desc f
                  where f.visit_date = c.visit_date
                    and f.visit_no = c.visit_no
                    and f.patient_id = c.patient_id) 诊断名称, -- 诊断名称
                (select dept_name
                   from dept_dict
                  where dept_code = c.visit_dept
                    AND ROWNUM = 1) 科室名称, --科室名称
                (select name from STAFF_DICT s where s.user_name = c.DOCTOR) 主治医生,
                a.TOTAL_COSTS 总费用, --费用总额
                c.CHARGE_TYPE 人员类别, --医疗类别  1 住院  2 长期护理 3 急诊观察 4 门诊慢特病5 意外伤害 6 普通门诊 7 特药
                YBFDJE 报销金额, -- 报销金额
                case a.YBPB
                  when 0 then
                   '自费'
                  when 1 then
                   '市医保普通'
                  when 2 then
                   '省医保'
                  when 3 then
                   '市医保门规'
                  when 4 then
                   '市医保急诊'
                  when 5 then
                   '省医保门规 '
                  when 6 then
                   '省内异地个账'
                  when 7 then
                   '工伤'
                  else
                   to_char(a.ybpb)
                end 结算类型
  from (SELECT max(rcpt_no) rcpt_no,
               brjsh,
               PATIENT_ID,
               visit_date,
               ybpb,
               sum(TOTAL_COSTS) TOTAL_COSTS,
               sum(TOTAL_CHARGES) TOTAL_CHARGES
          from outp_rcpt_master ac where ac.charge_indicator=0 
        --  where BRJSH is not null 区分自费
         GROUP BY brjsh, PATIENT_ID, visit_date, ybpb) a
  LEFT JOIN outp_order_desc b
    on a.rcpt_no = b.rcpt_no
  LEFT JOIN clinic_master c
    on b.clinic_no = c.clinic_no
  left join pat_master_index d
    on c.patient_id = d.patient_id
  LEFT JOIN PUB_PATIENTINFO_INSURE e
    on e.patient_id = a.patient_id
  left join INSURANCE.OUTP_RCPT_MASTER_yb ii
    on ii.patient_id = a.patient_id
   and ii.rcpt_no = a.rcpt_no
 where --c.patient_id='?
 b.patient_id||'-'|| to_char(b.visit_date, 'yyyymmdd') || b.visit_no in
 (select 唯一就诊标识 from INSUR_EXPORT.病理病人清单 where 就诊类型 = '门诊'))

create  table  INSUR_EXPORT.化验记录 as(

select 
a.patient_id as hisid,
    (case
         when VISIT_ID >0 then
          a.patient_id || a.visit_id
         else
          (select c.patient_id||'-'|| to_char(c.visit_date, 'yyyymmdd') || c.visit_no
             from outp_treat_rec s, outp_orders c
            where a.test_no = s.appoint_no
              and s.serial_no = c.serial_no
              and rownum = 1)
       end) as 唯一就诊标识, --  结算单号
       case
         when a.visit_id = 0 then
          (select c.clinic_no
             from outp_treat_rec s, outp_orders c
            where a.test_no = s.appoint_no
              and s.serial_no = c.serial_no
              and rownum = 1)
         else
          to_char(a.visit_id)
       end as 门诊住院流水号, --  门诊流水号/住院流水号
       a.patient_id as jzbs, -- 就诊标识
       nvl(b.Rm_Test_No, b.test_no) as 化验单号, --  化验单号
       decode(a.visit_id, '0', '门诊', '住院') as 就诊类别, -- 就诊类别  1住院，2长期护理，3急诊观察，4门诊慢特病，5意外伤害，6普通门诊，7特药，9其他
       nvl(a.execute_date, a.spcm_received_date_time) as 化验时间, --  化验时间
       (select aa.id_no
          from pat_master_index aa
         where aa.patient_id = a.patient_id) as 身份证号码, --  身份证号码
       a.name as 病人姓名, -- 病人姓名
       (select ks.dept_name
          from dept_dict ks
         where ks.dept_code = a.ORDERING_DEPT) as 开单科室, -- 开单科室
       (select ks.dept_name
          from dept_dict ks
         where ks.dept_code = a.PERFORMED_BY) as 执行科室, -- 执行科室
       b.item_code as 套餐包编码, --  套餐包编码
       b.item_name as 套餐包名称, --  套餐包名称
       nvl(c.LIS_CODE, c.REPORT_ITEM_CODE) as 详细化验项目编号, -- 详细化验项目编号
       c.REPORT_ITEM_NAME as 详细化验项目名称, -- 详细化验项目名称
       c.RESULT as 化验结果, -- 化验结果
       UNITS 单位,
       c.PRINT_CONTEXT as 参考值 -- 结果正常值范围
  from lab_test_master a
  left join lab_test_items b
    on a.test_no = b.test_no
  left join lab_result c
    on a.test_no = c.test_no
  left join pat_master_index pmi
    on pmi.patient_id = a.patient_id
  where a.visit_id > 0 and
  EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                  FROM INSUR_EXPORT.病理病人清单 lst
                 WHERE lst.唯一就诊标识 = a.patient_id || '-' || a.visit_id
                   AND lst.就诊类型    = '住院'
            ) 
      union all      
  select 
a.patient_id as hisid,
    (case
         when VISIT_ID >0 then
          a.patient_id || a.visit_id
         else
          (select c.patient_id||'-'|| to_char(c.visit_date, 'yyyymmdd') || c.visit_no
             from outp_treat_rec s, outp_orders c
            where a.test_no = s.appoint_no
              and s.serial_no = c.serial_no
              and rownum = 1)
       end) as 唯一就诊标识, --  结算单号
       case
         when a.visit_id = 0 then
          (select c.clinic_no
             from outp_treat_rec s, outp_orders c
            where a.test_no = s.appoint_no
              and s.serial_no = c.serial_no
              and rownum = 1)
         else
          to_char(a.visit_id)
       end as 门诊住院流水号, --  门诊流水号/住院流水号
       a.patient_id as jzbs, -- 就诊标识
       nvl(b.Rm_Test_No, b.test_no) as 化验单号, --  化验单号
       decode(a.visit_id, '0', '门诊', '住院') as 就诊类别, -- 就诊类别  1住院，2长期护理，3急诊观察，4门诊慢特病，5意外伤害，6普通门诊，7特药，9其他
       nvl(a.execute_date, a.spcm_received_date_time) as 化验时间, --  化验时间
       (select aa.id_no
          from pat_master_index aa
         where aa.patient_id = a.patient_id) as 身份证号码, --  身份证号码
       a.name as 病人姓名, -- 病人姓名
       (select ks.dept_name
          from dept_dict ks
         where ks.dept_code = a.ORDERING_DEPT) as 开单科室, -- 开单科室
       (select ks.dept_name
          from dept_dict ks
         where ks.dept_code = a.PERFORMED_BY) as 执行科室, -- 执行科室
       b.item_code as 套餐包编码, --  套餐包编码
       b.item_name as 套餐包名称, --  套餐包名称
       nvl(c.LIS_CODE, c.REPORT_ITEM_CODE) as 详细化验项目编号, -- 详细化验项目编号
       c.REPORT_ITEM_NAME as 详细化验项目名称, -- 详细化验项目名称
       c.RESULT as 化验结果, -- 化验结果
       UNITS 单位,
       c.PRINT_CONTEXT as 参考值 -- 结果正常值范围
  from lab_test_master a
  left join lab_test_items b
    on a.test_no = b.test_no
  left join lab_result c
    on a.test_no = c.test_no
  left join pat_master_index pmi
    on pmi.patient_id = a.patient_id
  where a.visit_id = 0 and
  EXISTS (
                   (

                  FROM outp_order_desc   g
                  JOIN INSUR_EXPORT.病理病人清单 lst
                    ON lst.唯一就诊标识 = g.patient_id||'-'|| to_char(g.visit_date, 'yyyymmdd') || g.visit_no
                   AND lst.就诊类型    = '门诊'
                 WHERE g.patient_id = a.patient_id
                   AND g.RCPT_NO    = a.RCPT_NO
            )
            )          
    )

SELECT SUM(今日在院人数) 今日在院人数,
       SUM(昨日出院人数) 昨日出院人数,
       SUM(今日出院人数) 今日出院人数,
       SUM(昨日入院人数) 昨日入院人数,
       SUM(今日入院人数) 今日入院人数,
       SUM(昨日危重人数) 昨日危重人数,
       SUM(今日危重人数) 今日危重人数
  FROM ( --在院人数
        SELECT COUNT(*) 今日在院人数,
                0 昨日出院人数,
                0 今日出院人数,
                0 昨日入院人数,
                0 今日入院人数,
                0 昨日危重人数,
                0 今日危重人数
          FROM PAT_VISIT V, PATS_IN_HOSPITAL H
         WHERE V.PATIENT_ID = H.PATIENT_ID
           AND V.VISIT_ID = H.VISIT_ID
           AND (V.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME IS NULL AND
               V.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM IS NULL)
           AND H.BED_NO IS NOT NULL
        --在院人数
        UNION ALL
        --出院人数
        SELECT 0 今日在院人数,
                COUNT(*) 昨日出院人数,
                0 今日出院人数,
                0 昨日入院人数,
                0 今日入院人数,
                0 昨日危重人数,
                0 今日危重人数
          FROM PAT_VISIT V
         WHERE V.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= TRUNC(SYSDATE - 1)
           AND V.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < TRUNC(SYSDATE)
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 0 今日在院人数,
                0 昨日出院人数,
                COUNT(*) 今日出院人数,
                0 昨日入院人数,
                0 今日入院人数,
                0 昨日危重人数,
                0 今日危重人数
          FROM PAT_VISIT V
         WHERE V.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
        --出院人数
        UNION ALL
        --入院人数
        SELECT 0 今日在院人数,
                0 昨日出院人数,
                0 今日出院人数,
                COUNT(*) 昨日入院人数,
                0 今日入院人数,
                0 昨日危重人数,
                0 今日危重人数
          FROM PAT_VISIT V
         WHERE V.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME >= TRUNC(SYSDATE - 1)
           AND V.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME < TRUNC(SYSDATE)
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 0 今日在院人数,
                0 昨日出院人数,
                0 今日出院人数,
                0 昨日入院人数,
                COUNT(*) 今日入院人数,
                0 昨日危重人数,
                0 今日危重人数
          FROM PAT_VISIT V
         WHERE V.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME > TRUNC(SYSDATE)
        --入院人数
        UNION ALL
        --危重人数
        SELECT 0 今日在院人数,
                0 昨日出院人数,
                0 今日出院人数,
                0 昨日入院人数,
                0 今日入院人数,
                COUNT(*) 昨日危重人数,
                0 今日危重人数
          FROM PAT_VISIT V
         WHERE V.PAT_ADM_CONDITION = '1'
           AND V.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME >= TRUNC(SYSDATE - 1)
           AND V.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < TRUNC(SYSDATE)
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 0 今日在院人数,
                0 昨日出院人数,
                0 今日出院人数,
                0 昨日入院人数,
                0 今日入院人数,
                0 昨日危重人数,
                COUNT(*) 今日危重人数
          FROM PAT_VISIT V
         WHERE V.PAT_ADM_CONDITION = '1'
           AND V.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
        --危重人数
        )

and (select count(1) from operation o where o.patient_id = v.patient_id

          FROM (SELECT C.ORDERED_BY_DOCTOR,
          c.ordered_by_dept,

                  FROM RECK_ITEM_CLASS_DICT A,
                       OUTP_BILL_ITEMS      B,

                   AND A.CLASS_CODE = B.CLASS_ON_RECKONING
                   AND B.VISIT_NO = C.VISIT_NO
                   AND B.VISIT_DATE = C.VISIT_DATE
                   AND B.VISIT_DATE >= to_date('?,'yyyyMMdd')
                   AND B.VISIT_DATE < to_date('?,'yyyyMMdd')
                 GROUP BY C.ORDERED_BY_DOCTOR, A.CLASS_NAME,c.ordered_by_dept) E,
               RECK_ITEM_CLASS_DICT D
         WHERE D.CLASS_NAME = E.SUBJ_NAME(+)
        UNION ALL
        SELECT A.DOCTOR, a.visit_dept ordered_by_dept,'挂号费' AS SUBJ_NAME, SUM(A.CLINIC_CHARGE)
          FROM CLINIC_MASTER A

           AND A.VISIT_DATE < to_date('?,'yyyyMMdd')
         GROUP BY A.DOCTOR, a.visit_dept
        UNION ALL
        SELECT A.DOCTOR, a.visit_dept ordered_by_dept, '挂号费' AS SUBJ_NAME, -SUM(B.CLINIC_CHARGE)

           AND B.RETURNED_DATE >= to_date('?,'yyyyMMdd')

SELECT DEPT_DICT.TJ_KSMC,
       Sum(nvl(ADM_OUTP_NUM, 0) + nvl(FROM_OTHER_HOSPITAL_NUM, 0) + nvl(CANCEL_DISCHARGE_NUM, 0)) IN_NUM,
       sum(nvl(DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION_RECOVER, 0) + nvl(DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION_EFFECT, 0) +
           nvl(DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION_INVALED, 0) + nvl(DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION_DIED, 0) +
           nvl(DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION_OTHER, 0))                                                   OUT_NUM,
       nvl(OPER_NUM.QTY, 0)                                                                       OPER_NUM
FROM DEPT_DICT
         LEFT JOIN DEPT_ADT_DAY ON DEPT_DICT.DEPT_CODE = DEPT_ADT_DAY.DEPT_CODE
         LEFT JOIN (SELECT TJ_KSMC, QTY
                    FROM (SELECT TJ_KSMC, QTY
                          FROM (SELECT TJ_KSMC, count(*) QTY
                                FROM (SELECT B.DEPT_NAME                   TJ_KSMC,
                                             (SELECT OPERATION
                                              FROM (SELECT E.PATIENT_ID,
                                                           E.VISIT_ID,
                                                           listagg(E.OPERATION, ' || ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY E.OPERATION) AS OPERATION
                                                    FROM OPERATION_NAME E
                                                    GROUP BY E.PATIENT_ID, E.VISIT_ID)
                                              WHERE PATIENT_ID = A.PATIENT_ID
                                                AND VISIT_ID = A.VISIT_ID) OPERATION_NAME
                                      FROM (SELECT A.START_DATE_TIME,
                                                   A.PATIENT_ID,
                                                   A.VISIT_ID,
                                                   (CASE
                                                        WHEN (SELECT count(1)
                                                              FROM LEND_BED_LOG
                                                              WHERE DEPT_CODE <> LEND_DEPT_CODE
                                                                AND PATIENT_ID = A.PATIENT_ID
                                                                AND VISIT_ID = A.VISIT_ID
                                                                AND LEND_END_DATE IS NOT NULL) > 0
                                                            THEN (SELECT LEND_DEPT_CODE
                                                                  FROM LEND_BED_LOG
                                                                  WHERE DEPT_CODE <> LEND_DEPT_CODE
                                                                    AND PATIENT_ID = A.PATIENT_ID
                                                                    AND VISIT_ID = A.VISIT_ID
                                                                    AND ROWNUM = 1)
                                                        ELSE A.OPERATING_DEPT END) OPERATING_DEPT
                                            FROM OPERATION_MASTER A
                                            WHERE A.START_DATE_TIME BETWEEN F_TODATE('?) AND F_TODATE('?)) A,
                                           DEPT_DICT B,
                                           PAT_MASTER_INDEX C
                                      WHERE A.OPERATING_DEPT = B.DEPT_CODE
                                        AND A.PATIENT_ID = C.PATIENT_ID)
                                GROUP BY TJ_KSMC))) OPER_NUM ON DEPT_DICT.TJ_KSMC = OPER_NUM.TJ_KSMC AND QTY > 0
WHERE ST_DATE BETWEEN F_TODATE('?) AND F_TODATE('?)
-- AND DEPT_DICT.DEPT_CODE IN (SELECT V_DEPT_INP.DEPT_CODE FROM V_DEPT_INP)
GROUP BY DEPT_DICT.TJ_KSMC, OPER_NUM.QTY
HAVING Sum(nvl(ADM_OUTP_NUM, 0) + nvl(FROM_OTHER_HOSPITAL_NUM, 0) + nvl(CANCEL_DISCHARGE_NUM, 0)) > 0
OR sum(nvl(DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION_RECOVER, 0) + nvl(DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION_EFFECT, 0) +
           nvl(DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION_INVALED, 0) + nvl(DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION_DIED, 0) +
           nvl(DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION_OTHER, 0)) > 0

SELECT CC.时间,
       SUM(CC.出院人数) 出院人数,
       SUM(CC.出院病人占用总床日数) 出院病人占用总床日数
--        ,       ROUND((SUM(CC.出院病人占用总床日数) / SUM(CC.出院人数)), 2) 出院病人平均住院日
  FROM (SELECT TRUNC(A.ST_DATE) 时间,
               SUM(DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION_RECOVER +
                   DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION_EFFECT +
                   DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION_INVALED +
                   DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION_DIED + DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION_OTHER) 出院人数,
               0 出院病人占用总床日数
          FROM DEPT_ADT_DAY A
         WHERE A.ST_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM')
           AND A.ST_DATE < TRUNC(SYSDATE)
         GROUP BY A.ST_DATE
        UNION ALL
        SELECT TRUNC(B.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME) 时间,
               0 出院人数,
               SUM(TRUNC(B.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME - B.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME + 1)) 出院病人占用总床日数
          FROM PAT_VISIT V, TRANSFER B
         WHERE V.PATIENT_ID = B.PATIENT_ID
           AND V.VISIT_ID = B.VISIT_ID
           AND V.ADMISSION_CAUSE <> '新生儿'
           AND B.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM')
         GROUP BY B.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME
        UNION ALL
        SELECT TRUNC(SYSDATE) 时间,
               COUNT(*) 出院人数,
               0 出院病人占用总床日数
          FROM PAT_VISIT V
         WHERE V.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
           AND V.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM IS NOT NULL) CC
 GROUP BY CC.时间
 ORDER BY CC.时间

SELECT 时间, sum(出院人数) 出院人数, sum(出院病人占用总床日数) 出院病人占用总床日数
FROM (

       SUM(DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION_RECOVER +
           DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION_EFFECT +

       0                                                             出院病人占用总床日数
FROM DEPT_ADT_DAY A
WHERE A.ST_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM')
  AND A.ST_DATE < TRUNC(SYSDATE)
GROUP BY A.ST_DATE
UNION ALL
SELECT TRUNC(B.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME)                                  时间,
       0                                                             出院人数,
       SUM(TRUNC(B.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME - B.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME + 1)) 出院病人占用总床日数
FROM PAT_VISIT V, TRANSFER B
WHERE V.PATIENT_ID = B.PATIENT_ID
  AND V.VISIT_ID = B.VISIT_ID
  AND V.ADMISSION_CAUSE <> '新生儿'
  AND B.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM')
GROUP BY B.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME
UNION ALL
SELECT TRUNC(SYSDATE) 时间,

WHERE V.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
